attributes.name: hero button pairing style
attributes.definition: How the hero's call-to-action buttons are differentiated from each other visually (fill vs outline hierarchy, or uniform treatment).

values.definition: One solid-filled primary button paired with an outlined/ghost secondary button.
All hero actions share the same bordered tile treatment with no primary/secondary fill hierarchy.
Only one hero action is present.
Different arrangement or no hero buttons.

attributes.name: hero action shape
attributes.definition: The outline shape and corner treatment of hero action buttons.

values.definition: Rectangular buttons or tiles with softly rounded corners.
Shape not asserted or no hero actions.

attributes.name: hero action trailing icon
attributes.definition: Whether hero action labels end with an icon or glyph.

values.definition: Labels end with a right-pointing arrow.
Labels end with a non-arrow icon.
Plain text labels without a trailing glyph.
